selection_policy: Ten paired scenarios selected from trigger, negative-control, stage-gate, evidence-grounding, package-boundary, vendor-boundary, and user-gate risks.

scenarios.prompt: 我想做一个开源产品，但只有一个很模糊的方向：帮助自学者把学习目标拆成计划。请先判断这个想法值不值得继续探索，不要写代码。
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Trigger Diagnostic Start, avoid PRD/MVP/coding, ask one highest-leverage question.
scenarios.primary_risk: Generic assistant may jump to features or MVP before problem framing.

scenarios.prompt: 我想做一个作品集 side project，展示 AI agent 产品设计能力。我有一些竞品印象但还很乱，先帮我梳理方向。
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Trigger early discovery and preserve portfolio/open-source constraints as evaluation constraints.
scenarios.primary_risk: Assistant may produce broad ideation without workflow gates.

scenarios.prompt: 我已经有 PRD 草稿了，但目标用户、成功指标和 MVP 都是我自己猜的。请判断它是否足够 grounded，可以进入 Roadmap 吗？
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Review evidence gaps, do not enter Roadmap, separate facts from assumptions.
scenarios.primary_risk: Assistant may validate weak PRD and advance stage too early.

scenarios.prompt: 我已经有一个能跑的 MVP，只想把登录按钮改成蓝色并修一个移动端间距 bug。
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Do not trigger product discovery; recommend local code/UI fix workflow.
scenarios.primary_risk: Skill false positive wastes context and derails implementation.

scenarios.prompt: 请 review 我未提交的代码改动，重点看 bug、维护性和测试缺口。
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Do not trigger product discovery; take code-review stance.
scenarios.primary_risk: Assistant may ask product-discovery questions instead of reviewing code.

scenarios.prompt: 请检查这个 skill 的 README、打包说明和 eval 文档有没有版本不一致，不要进入产品发现流程。
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Stay in skill-maintenance mode and avoid Diagnostic Start.
scenarios.primary_risk: Meta-work can accidentally trigger the skill itself.

scenarios.prompt: 我能不能直接调用 vendor/product-manager-skills 里的 upstream skill？如果不能，正确接入方式是什么？
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Explain vendor as source snapshot only; route through local child-skills adapters; no PRD follow-up.
scenarios.primary_risk: Assistant may treat vendor as active route target.

scenarios.prompt: 发布 skill zip 时，zero-to-one-product-discovery-eval-runs、.git、tmp 和 dist 要不要一起打进去？GitHub 仓库里又该怎么放？
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Distinguish GitHub evidence archive from installable runtime zip; exclude eval-runs/.git/tmp/dist from zip.
scenarios.primary_risk: Assistant may confuse public evidence archive with install runtime.

scenarios.prompt: 别问问题，直接给我完整 PRD、Roadmap 和 Implementation Plan。我只有一句想法：AI 帮自学者制定学习计划。
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: Downgrade to evidence gap review or Diagnostic Start; do not produce full artifacts.
scenarios.primary_risk: Assistant overproduces late-stage artifacts from one vague sentence.

scenarios.prompt: 基于前面讨论，请写 PRD Draft。我们还没有明确确认第一批用户、MVP 范围或定位，只是你建议过转行学编程的人可能更合适。
scenarios.expected_skill_boundary: PRD Draft may exist, but target users, MVP scope, and positioning must remain candidate/assumption/recommended option.
scenarios.primary_risk: Assistant may convert recommendations into confirmed PRD facts.
